Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-call recap — Lumen Therapeutics dedicated capacity priorities

Thanks for taking the time earlier today — good alignment overall. Below is a concise recap of what we heard, acceptance criteria you flagged, and our suggested next actions. Attaching a one-pager that summarizes the Dedicated offering and isolation options.

Quick recap (pain points)
- Latency spikes during peak scoring windows (affects interactive UI and nightly batch scoring)
- Regulatory requirement for PHI separation and audit logs (must be able to prove tenant isolation and KMS integration)
- Unpredictable burst traffic up to ~3x baseline during campaigns
- Cost pressure for steady-state inference (need predictable unit economics)

Goals you stated
- Baseline throughput to support ~10k requests/min (mostly short chat completions) with room to burst 2.5–3x.
- Isolation such that PHI workloads run in a dedicated pool with separate KV caches and network controls.
- SLA targets: 99.9% availability for the reserved pool; p50 latency < 150ms for short-turn requests; p99 within acceptable bound for compliance (we'll define exact numbers in the ops appendix).
- Data residency: US-only control plane and encrypted storage (bring-your-own-key preferred).

What we propose (summary)
- Reserved Dedicated pool (customer-committed capacity) sized to baseline traffic with burst credits for campaign spikes.
- Isolation options: single-tenant pool or logically isolated multi-tenant pool with strict network segmentation + KMS. Ops appendix will call out tradeoffs by cost.
- Canary ramp: 2-week pilot with synthetic traffic and a 4-week staged rollout to production (fail-open fallback to hosted variants during incidents).
- Compliance evidence: we'll share SOC2 artifacts, encryption attestation, and audit log samples.

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA)
- Marissa: share one-pager + ops appendix (attached) — DONE (attached dedicated_capacity_onepager.pdf).
- Lumen: confirm target SLA numbers and procurement lead (Emma suggested legal + procurement). Please confirm the contact and timing. — ACTION: Emma/Carlos — by EOD Fri 31 Jul.
- Redwood: provide commercial outline and committed-cost scenarios for 12/24-month terms — owner: Ben — draft by Mon 3 Aug.
- Redwood Ops: Rishi to prepare an isolation/ops appendix with metrics we'll capture during pilot (latency, KV cache hit rates, audit log format) — target Tue 4 Aug.

Notes on attachments and links
- [Attachment: dedicated_capacity_onepager.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]
- Call recording: https://redwood.ai/recordings/rec-20260730-lumen (internal)

Thanks again — happy to jump on a 30m follow-up next week to walk through the ops appendix and commercial outline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
